title: To Your Eternity
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A being called the Beholder sends an immortal orb into the world; it takes the shapes of a wolf and then a boy, becoming Fushi. Over centuries Fushi learns to be human through those he loves and loses, while fighting Nokkers that steal his forms.
life_message: A good life means letting others' love shape you, even through repeated loss.

content.note: Repeated deaths, battles, gladiatorial combat, murder (Wikipedia); AniList Gore 60%.
Constant loss of loved ones (Wikipedia; AniList Tragedy, Survival).
Grief, isolation for decades, dementia (Wikipedia); AniList Suicide and Bullying signals.
